faq.q: What AI courses do you offer?
faq.a: Prompt engineering for business, document workflow automation with AI, AI in HR processes, building AI agents, working with data and analytics, neural networks and AI for executives.

faq.q: Do I need technical experience for AI courses?
faq.a: No, our courses are designed for business users with no technical background. The focus is on practical use of AI in everyday work tasks.

faq.q: How much do AI courses cost?
faq.a: On the 2026 schedule — {minPrice} to {maxPrice} ₸ per participant, depending on the course and format. Online is cheaper than in person. We adapt corporate training to the company's industry and tasks.
Prompt engineering is the skill of interacting effectively with AI tools. In the course you will learn to write precise requests for ChatGPT, Claude and other neural networks to solve business tasks.

faq.q: How can AI help the HR department?
faq.a: AI automates HR routine: resume screening, writing job descriptions, engagement analysis, creating training materials, answering employees' standard questions.

faq.q: Is there practice on the courses?
faq.a: Yes, the courses are built on practice: every participant works with AI tools and leaves with ready-made prompts and templates for their own work.
